name: Oil of Sharpness

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 1 minute to apply: a Slashing or Piercing weapon (or 5 pieces of such ammunition) becomes +3 for 1 hour.
text: Clear and jelly-like, this oil glitters with minute silver slivers. In 1 minute you can coat either a single Melee weapon or as many as 5 pieces of ammunition, as long as they deal Slashing or Piercing damage. The coated item then gains +3 to attack and damage rolls for 1 hour.
